text: Natural language processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It enables machines to read, interpret, and even generate text in a meaningful way. For example, NLP powers translation tools that convert sentences from one language to another, keeping the meaning intact. It is also used in sentiment analysis, which examines social media posts or reviews to determine if the writer feels positive, negative, or neutral. Additionally, chatbots rely on NLP to understand customer questions and provide helpful answers. From helping people communicate across cultures to improving online experiences, NLP is changing how we interact with technology in our daily lives.
